comment: Initial /dashboard bundle-size budgets (#7111). Gated on raw bytes: per chunk ±max(2048 B, 2%), total ±max(16384 B, 0.25%). The "deferred" section gates the application graph the entry imports on every visit with the same tolerances. Tolerance fields here are informational — the gate enforces its own constants and rejects a snapshot that disagrees. Regenerate after "VITE_VARIANT=full ./node_modules/.bin/vite build" with: npm run bundle:budgets
